result.title: DeepMind's CTO Explains Their Invisible "AI Watermark"
result.description:
Did you know your phone can easily tell you which videos or images or AI?

AI videos are getting so realistic to the point where it's bordering on scary. So I point blank asked the CTO of Google DeepMind at Google I/O this year: What is your company doing about this?

His answer was pretty cutting edge: Deepmind build a system called SynthID, an invisible digital watermark baked right into AI-generated content.

So if you’re ever watching a video and think, "Wait, is this real?", you can literally just use Circle to Search on your phone or drop the content into the Gemini app and ask, “Is this AI?”

It will instantly scan the invisible watermark and tell you the truth. 

Send this to someone who NEEDS to know about this (or tag that one friend who always falls for fake AI videos...)

#AI #Gemini #GoogleDeepMind #genAI #aiart

result.title: ChatGPT Finance Is Freaking People Out
result.description:
This is getting a lot of controversy...

OpenAI just rolled out a new personal finance experience that lets you link your bank accounts directly to ChatGPT via Plaid. 

The pros are that it allows you to basically have a financial advisor at your fingertips. But the cons is that people are worried about the privacy and safety implications of giving a for-profit company that makes money off ads access to your spending habits, investments, and travel history.

Are the potential financial gains and knowledge worth the risk, or is it a big NO for you?

#ai #AInews #chatGPT #openai #aiprivacy

result.title: Is Google Search Officially Dead?
result.description:
Is the OG Google search officially dead? 💀

At Google I/O, they announced that the tech giant is essentially replacing traditional search with an AI engine. It's not the most surprising move, but it has been very controversial.

By pushing AI overviews to the top of search and scraping info from blogs and videos to give you AI answers, Google is actively keeping people from clicking into organic websites that rely on that traffic to stay alive.

Not only can that jeopardize many small creators, but it also begs the question: if those creators lose their traffic and stop making content... what is the AI going to pull its answers from? 

#Ai #AInews #googleIO #gemini #contentcreation

result.title: The Top Announcements From Google I/O
result.description:
I had the opportunity to attend Google I/O this past week and speak directly with the Google DeepMind team about their latest releases. There were a bajillion announcements, so here's only what matters most:

▪️ Gemini 3.5 Flash: it's the first release in the new Gemini 3.5 family of models. It is designed to be a faster, more cost-effective option and is available now, with the full-fledged Gemini 3.5 Pro scheduled to launch later.

▪️ Gemini Omni: a new multimodal model focused on content editing and creation (they're calling it the "Nano Banana of video"). Right now it accepts video inputs with audio and image capabilities coming soon. 

▪️ Gemini Spark: Google's version of OpenClaw or Hermes. It's a 24/7 autonomous AI agent, but unlike the open-source options that require local computing power, Spark runs entirely on Google’s servers. 

Save this video so you remember to give one or all of these a try!

#GoogleIO #AI #gemini #ainews #aiagents
